name: find-and-fix-ripgrep-paths
description: Diagnose a bug report by finding hardcoded paths and adding a fallback. Search + targeted edit workflow.
task: Bug report: the grep tool can't find ripgrep on NixOS systems where rg is at /usr/bin/env. The GrepTool has a hardcoded list of candidate paths it searches. Add /usr/bin/env as an additional fallback at the end of that list.
